hints.title: Rearranging Equation
hints.text: The condition nums[a] + nums[b] + nums[c] == nums[d] with a < b < c < d can be rearranged as nums[a] + nums[b] == nums[d] - nums[c].

hints.title: Middle Boundary Pivot
hints.text: Fix the index b. All pairs (c, d) with b < c < d can be maintained in a frequency hash map of differences nums[d] - nums[c].

hints.title: Backward Sweep
hints.text: Iterate b backwards from n - 3 down to 1. Add all differences nums[d] - nums[b + 1] to the count map, then sum count[nums[a] + nums[b]] for all a < b.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Splitting 4-element search into two pairs (a, b) and (c, d) with a frequency table.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all 4 indices naively takes O(N^4) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Middle-split difference counting drops time complexity from quartic to quadratic.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize pair-splitting or optimize loops to O(N^2) or O(N^3).
